_note: Small random events inside the nest, docs/04-colony.md (Nest events). Only good or harmless. Times are hours at world speed 1 (divide by world speed). A gift is giftHours of the colony's current production of that resource (at least minGift), never more than fits in storage. Colonies of inactive players get no events.

lost_beetle.title: A lost beetle wandered into the nest
lost_beetle.text: A beetle took a wrong turn down your entrance. It did not take a second one.

aphid_boom.title: Aphid boom on the nearby stems
aphid_boom.text: The aphids are thriving this week. Your herders came home sticky and proud.

leaf_fall.title: A gust dropped fresh leaves by the entrance
leaf_fall.text: No cutting, no carrying from afar: the wind did the hard part today.

rain_drums.title: Rain drummed on the soil
rain_drums.text: The colony pulled in close and waited it out. The tunnels held. Nobody minded the quiet.

nuptial_flight.title: Winged ants rose from a neighbouring nest
nuptial_flight.text: Your workers stopped to watch the nuptial flight. Somewhere, new colonies are starting.

old_tunnel.title: Diggers broke into an old, empty tunnel
old_tunnel.text: Someone lived here long ago. Your scouts sniffed every corner and found only stories.
